items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: But you know Errol has influenced all of piano you know, purposely and also accidentally.

ctx.x: But apparently he thinks Errol would have played a little more behind the beat.

Yeah, sure. You know, but that’s the difference because I’m not him. But you know Errol has influenced all of piano you know, purposely and also accidentally. Because there’s a lot of pianists I’m sure that they don’t even think about him when they play but he’s in there, you know, out of just functionality of how he used the piano. I mean everything he did made so much sense to do. How to play jazz piano. He’s one of the masters of how to actually play it you know, how to shape music. How to be free within the…
Can you expand on that a little bit, how to be free within the form? What’s the first step of being free?
